definitions.explanation: The surface of water as shaped by waves.
In physics, a surface connecting all points of a wave that are in the same phase of oscillation.

notes:
Composed of {波|は} (wave) + ⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ (surface). Has both an everyday literary sense (the visible surface of water with waves) and a technical physics sense (wavefront). The literary sense appears in nature descriptions, while the technical sense is used in optics, acoustics, and wave physics.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {波面|はめん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れ→揺れ：16137_yure⟧: rippling of the wave surface
- {波面|はめん}{収差|しゅうさ}: wavefront aberration (optics)
- {波面|はめん}⟦{補正|ほせい}→補正：18527_hosei⟧: wavefront correction

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水面|すいめん}→水面：04307_suimen⟧: water surface — the flat surface of water regardless of waves
- ⟦{海面|かいめん}→海面：15838_kaimen⟧: sea surface — specifically the surface of the ocean
- {波頭|はとう}: wave crest — the peak of a wave, not the entire surface
